documents.title: AI Privacy & Security
documents.quality_note: Campus rules on data privacy and prohibited use of generative AI (no sensitive or FERPA data in AI tools), plus pointers to CSU systemwide Ethical and Responsible Use guidance. Says nothing about coursework or academic integrity.

documents.unit: Center for Teaching and Learning (Academic Affairs)
documents.title: Course Preparation
documents.quality_note: Known URL from earlier pass. One instruction to faculty to state in the syllabus how AI will or will not be allowed, and to consult the department; a pointer to a Padlet of AI/ChatGPT resources. Otherwise a general course-preparation page.

notes: No Sac State-specific academic-integrity rule on AI was found; a 2023 student newspaper quote says the Academic Dishonesty Policy has no explicit AI rule (news, not collected). Faculty and student guidance is issued at CSU systemwide level (genai.calstate.edu, 'Guidelines for Faculty Regarding AI in Instruction'; 'CSU Ethical and Responsible Use'); not collected because it is system-level, not Sac State's own document. Computing: searched csc.csus.edu / ecs.csus.edu / athena.ecs.csus.edu; only pre-AI academic-honesty pages and individual course syllabi turned up (course layer deferred). Sac State College of Engineering and Computer Science has no AI policy page found. Other Sac State AI pages (ChatGPT Edu, AI-enabled software) are tool listings and were not collected.
